summary: Build, startup, unit, and approved-lint contracts are preserved, but scheduled lifecycle database credentials are read from process.env instead of the Worker env supplied by the scheduled handler.

findings.message: runAcademyIdentityLifecyclePull receives Worker env, but resolveDependencies defaults to academyDb(), which reads process.env.ACADEMY_DATA_API_URL and ACADEMY_DATA_API_JWT_SECRET. The declared compatibility configuration does not guarantee process.env population, so an enabled scheduled pull can fail to obtain its database binding. Pass the supplied environment into createAcademyDb or explicitly adopt a supported process-env population contract.
